extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and advanced students interested in classical/projective geometry and methods for integrating linear differential equations
extracted.subtask_description: Exposition of the theory of collineation in projective geometry including constructions, analytic relations between corresponding points/lines, applications to transversals and conic sections, properties of hyperboloids, followed by a separate article on a new method for integrating certain linear differential equations. Contains theorems, constructions, analytic derivations, and example integrations.
